LAO Tacloban Everlast Trucking Brgy. 64, Diversion Road, Bluss Sagcahan, Tacloban City Dear Mr. Lao: DILG Legal Opinion No. IIS. 2013 1 1 APR 2013 This refers to your 19 February 2013 letter which requests the Department's legal opinion as to the effectivity and status of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2011•-151 (MC 2011-151), a copy of which is attached to your letter together with the 11 February 2013 generic letter from the Provincial Treasurer of Laguna providing information on the imposition of the annual fixed tax of P500.0() for all types of vehicles being used to directly or indirectly carry or distribute goods or merchandise within the jurisdiction of the Province of Laguna pursuant to Section 2.29 of Provincial Tax Ordinance No. 01-92, Provincial Tax Ordinance No. 01-94, SP Resolution No. 582, s. 1994. Please be informed that MC 2011-151 is a reiteration of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2006-70 (MC 2006-70), which was amended by DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2013-04. MC 2006-70 was enforced by the Department on 26 January 2006 and is still effective to date. The subject Of said MC is the suspension of the local government unit (LGU) imposition and collection of illegal fees and taxes, particularly pass through fees which is defined under Section 133 (e) of Republic Act No. 7160 (RA 7160) as taxes, fees, charges and other impositions upon goods carried into or out of, or passing through the territorial jurisdiction of the LGUs in the guise of a toll, charges for wharfage or others taxes, fees, or charges in any form upon goods or merchandise. Local ordinances imposing/collecting taxes, fees or charges on the types of subjects enumerated under Section 133 are considered illegal based on the definition of an illegal imposition under DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2009-42 dated 27 March 2009, to wit: "Illegal imposition pertains to the levy of taxes, fees and charges duly illiposed by a local government unit on a certain subject through an appropriate ordinance but is, hotvever, outside the scope of its taxing and revenue-raising powers vis-å-ois the statutory scope of [nxing powers of provinces, cities, numicipalities and barangays as are conferred to them by the Local Government Code.
